audit.why: 53.92% over 306 games. Swain owns levels 1-3 on Death's Hand and Vision of Empire chip; Cho'Gath's Carnivore sustain and the Rupture-Scream chain take the lane back from 4 onward. The prose already states this, and diff EVEN / 6.0 fits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart is inverted through the middle four stages. Levels 2 and 3 are scored Cho'Gath while the page's own spikes[0] is titled 'Swain's window', the early prose opens 'Swain owns levels 1-3 here', and whys[1] literally says 'concede the early levels'. Levels 4-5 and Level 6 are scored Skill while whys[3] says Cho'Gath's sustain stabilises the lane and whys[4] says 'his R can't heal through your execute'.
audit.why: Mechanically the early concession is right: Nevermove (850 range) plus Death's Hand at 7s means a rooted, dashless Cho'Gath eats a free full combo before Feral Scream exists. And 6 is decisively Cho'Gath's — Demonic Ascension sustains only while Swain drains, and Feast's true damage is an execute no amount of draining answers.
audit.corrected: Level 2 Swain (3/10), Level 3 Swain (3/10), Levels 4-5 Cho'Gath, Level 6 Cho'Gath (7/10). Proposed as one atomic chart group across both layers; the whys[] text already reads correctly and needs no change.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the full layer 'never names any of Swain's abilities', and the two decisive mechanics are missing. (a) Nevermove (E) is a boomerang: the wave travels out and ROOTS ON ITS RETURN, so the correct dodge for an immobile Cho'Gath is to step TOWARD Swain, not retreat into the return path. The page only ever says 'get E-rooted' with generic filler underneath. (b) Death's Hand (Q) deals more damage per bolt struck, so at point-blank every bolt lands — melee-hugging Swain is the worst place to stand unless you are committing.
audit.why: Riot text — Nevermove: 'Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer.' 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, 850 range, projectile. Death's Hand: 'bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.' 7/6/5/4/3s, 750 range. Demonic Ascension: flat 120s at all three ranks, 650 range, 'indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions'. Vision of Empire: 22s at rank 1, 5500-7500 range, and it grants Swain a Soul Fragment when it hits a champion — his poke literally feeds his permanent health.
audit.corrected: Nevermove's return-trip root written into dontsFull[1], report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns with the 12s number; Death's Hand's per-bolt stacking written into dontsFull[2]; Demonic Ascension's flat 120s written into dosFull[0].d.

audit.why: Nevermove at 12s is the button that decides lane trades; Demonic Ascension at a flat 120s is the button that decides fights. Both belong there with their numbers.
